slides.texte_overlay:
How to become a rare young man
in a world of average
Keep your word when it's inconvenient. Most people cancel when something better comes up. Reliable men are rare.
Read books, not just posts. A few real books a year give you ideas and depth most people your age never get. Read daily.
Know how to cook, fix and organise. Practical skills make you independent and useful to everyone around you. Learn one skill a month.
Treat women, elders and strangers with respect. Good manners have become rare, so they stand out more than ever.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Steady curiosity is one of the rarest traits today.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Steady curiosity is one of the rarest traits today.

slides.texte_overlay: Take your health seriously. Training, sleep, real food. Most men wait until 40. Starting now puts you years ahead.
Stay humble. Learn from everyone, brag about nothing. Quiet confidence is what makes a man truly rare. Be that man.
